  lib/udp/lpi_wireguard.cc
  lib/udp/lpi_wolfet.cc
  lib/udp/lpi_worm_22105.cc
  lib/udp/lpi_xfire_p2p.cc
  lib/udp/lpi_xlsp.cc
  lib/udp/lpi_xunlei.cc
  lib/udp/lpi_xunlei_jsq.cc
  lib/udp/lpi_xunyou.cc
  lib/udp/lpi_youdao_dict.cc
  lib/udp/lpi_youku.cc
  lib/udp/lpi_yuanfudao.cc
  lib/udp/lpi_yy_udp.cc
  lib/udp/lpi_zalo_call.cc
  lib/udp/lpi_zeroaccess_udp.cc
  lib/udp/lpi_zoom.cc
)
add_library(sakamoto_lpi STATIC ${LPI_SOURCES} adapter.cc)
file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/config.h"
  CONTENT "/* feature-only upstream build */\n" @ONLY)
target_include_directories(sakamoto_lpi PRIVATE lib "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
target_compile_definitions(sakamoto_lpi PRIVATE SAKAMOTO_LPI_FEATURES_ONLY=1)
target_compile_features(sakamoto_lpi PRIVATE cxx_std_11)
target_compile_options(sakamoto_lpi PRIVATE -fvisibility=hidden -Wno-unused-parameter)
set_target_properties(sakamoto_lpi PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

install(FILES COPYING COPYING.LESSER README.md upstream-manifest.json
  DESTINATION share/licenses/sakamoto/libprotoident)
